question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on an amount of ₹4,000 deposited on 21 February 2024 and withdrawn on 22 April 2024 at 6.75% per annum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

2024 is a leap year, so the total number of days in the year is 366.

Time period = 8 days (Feb) + 31 days (Mar) + 22 days (Apr) = 61 days = 1/6 years.

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

SI = 4000 × 6.75 × (1 ÷ 6) ÷ 100

SI = 40 × 1.125 = ₹45

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6.75% per annum

Time period (T) = 21 February 2024 to 22 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ The year 2024 is divisible by 4, meaning it is a leap year with 366 days (February has 29 days).

⇒ Total days = (29 − 21) days in Feb + 31 days in Mar + 22 days in Apr

⇒ Total days = 8 + 31 + 22 = 61 days

⇒ Time (T) in years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 years

⇒ SI = (4000 × 6.75 × (1 ÷ 6)) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 40 × 6.75 ÷ 6

⇒ SI = 40 × 1.125

⇒ SI = 45

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Leap Year Calculation

In a leap year, the month of February has 29 days, making the total number of days in the year 366. For interest calculations, time in years (T) = Number of days ÷ 366.

Bank Day Counting Rule

When calculating simple interest on bank deposits over a specific date range, either the day of deposit or the day of withdrawal is included, but not both. Taking the exact difference in days correctly applies this rule.

Simple vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated solely on the initial principal (SI = P × R × T ÷ 100), whereas Compound Interest includes interest earned on previously accumulated interest.
